title: Credit Approval Workflow
subtitle: Each application is a fully traceable node on the graph — the ontology powers not just Q&A, but the review workflow itself.
emptyCasesHint: Once an ApprovalCase is modeled in the ontology, it will appear here.
fusionNote: The ontology unifies facts scattered across separate systems into one shared business language (company–facility–guarantee–collateral): guarantee rings, related-party penetration and over-limit exposure only emerge once the dots are connected.
silo_credit_desc: Company, facility, guarantee, pledge, purchase-sale entities & relations
silo_policy_desc: Unified credit-limit and guarantee-ring review rules
silo_market_desc: Listed-company prices and stock pledge ratios
silo_collateral_desc: On-site imaging of the pledged plant
graphEmpty: No related nodes found for this case.
templateModalSub: Both workflows reuse the same ontology graph — they just read the same entities and relationships from a different angle.
templateCreditDesc: Intake → compliance review → credit deliberation → approval resolution → post-loan management, with Agent assistance and human approval.
templateFraudDesc: Lead intake → fund-flow penetration → ring detection → suspicious determination → disposal handover, an anti-fraud lens over the same entity graph.
fraudSubtitle: Same ontology graph, different lens — guarantee and fund relationships are re-narrated as closed fund loops and ring leads under the anti-fraud view.
fraudBanner: This lens reuses the same ontology graph, read from an anti-fraud angle: the triangular mutual-guarantee ring = a closed fund-loop red flag; Huijia as an 'independent third party' = a shell conduit.
dockIntro: Run Agent-assisted reasoning and human approval here — without interrupting the case graph on the left.
dockNoCase: Select an approval case on the left first.
agentComplianceDesc: Runs in the contract-graph extraction project: detects guarantee rings, penetrates the 'independent third-party' guarantor, and checks group-level exposure against the unified credit limit.
agentCompliancePrompt: Run a compliance review on Shenlan Precision's 80M credit application: detect guarantee rings, penetrate the actual control relationship of the 'independent third-party' guarantor Huijia Investment, and check whether group exposure exceeds the unified credit limit. State each risk finding and its basis.
agentDeliberationDesc: Runs in the credit-review-report project: consolidates guarantee ring, related-party penetration, group exposure, SAIC dependency, stock pledge and litigation, and issues an approve/reject recommendation.
agentDeliberationPrompt: Issue a credit deliberation opinion for Shenlan Precision's 80M credit: consolidate the guarantee ring, related-party penetration, group exposure, SAIC dependency, stock pledge and litigation/public opinion, and give an approve/reject recommendation with reasons.
agentThinking: Agent is reasoning, please wait (about 1-3 min)…
approvalHint: The Agent has provided a deliberation opinion; the final decision is made by the reviewer. The result is written back to the ontology and synced to the graph.
approvalSaved: Decision written back and graph synced
approvalFailed: Failed to write back the decision
chatGreeting: Hi, I'm the AI credit assistant. Ask me about guarantee rings, group exposure, related-party penetration or risk points — I query the ontology graph live and answer with sources.
chatPlaceholder: Ask the AI credit assistant… (Enter to send)
chip_1: Is Shenlan Precision in a guarantee ring? Which companies are involved?
chip_2: Adding this 80M facility to the group's existing exposure, does it exceed the unified credit limit?
chip_3: Is Huijia Investment an independent third party, or is it related to Shenlan Precision?
chip_4: What are the main risk points of this credit application?
stage0_empty: No due-diligence files yet — upload materials to the credit-archive channel first.
stage1_ring_concl: Detected a triangular mutual-guarantee ring: Jialan → Shenlan Precision → Lanting → Jialan (extendable to Lanxin live).
stage1_penetration_concl: Huijia Investment penetrates to the ultimate controller via Zhao Guoqing → Shen Huifang → Lu Zhenbang — not an independent third party.
stage1_exposure_concl: Consolidated group exposure of 550M exceeds the 450M unified credit limit by 100M.
stage1_askHint: Ask the AI credit assistant for details
stage2_concl: Weighing the guarantee ring, related-party penetration, over-limit exposure, 68% SAIC dependency and breached pledge ratio — recommendation: reject / conditional approval requires compressing exposure within the limit.
stage2_reportHint: A full report can be generated by the AI assistant.
stage4_body: Shenlan Holdings pledged 3M shares of SAIC Motor (600104.SH) as credit enhancement; maintenance ratio warning line 140% / liquidation line 120%. At the latest close, the maintenance ratio has fallen below the liquidation line (driven by real market data).
fraudStagePanel: The anti-fraud lens reuses the same ontology graph — ask the AI assistant for per-stage details.
